selected.title: European payments groups join forces to take on US giants
selected.summary: Some of Europe's biggest payments groups - Bancomat, Bizum, Wero, Sibs-MB WAY and Vipps MobilePay - have banded together to create a cross-continent network that can take on Visa and Mastercard.
selected.why: Major European payment schemes unite to build a cross-border alternative to Visa and Mastercard.

reason: European payments groups uniting against US giants raises arguable questions about whether fragmentation or consolidation better serves competition and innovation in payments.
angle: European payments consolidation will reduce competition and consumer choice rather than strengthen it against US dominance.
